youtube.title: Why Hotels Skip the 13th Floor (It's Still There) #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
You press 14, but you're not on the 14th floor. In 2002 an Otis Elevator executive estimated that about 85% of their tall buildings had no button marked 13. So where did the floor go?

From the Last Supper and Norse myth to the Thirteen Club of 1881 and the first skyscrapers, this is the story of how an ancient fear quietly reshaped modern buildings, and why the 13th floor never really disappeared.
